newsitem.title: USA: ITT completes hotels sales to FelCor.
newsitem.headline: ITT completes hotels sales to FelCor.

text.p: ITT Corp said Monday it had completed the sale of five ITT Sheraton Hotels for $200 million cash to FelCor Suite Hotels Inc.
Under the terms of the deal, Sheraton has a contract to manage the hotels for 20 years.
The companies announced an agreement in principle on May 19 and a definitive agreement on June 9.
ITT said ITT Sheraton will help identify acquisition opportunities for FelCor and will make available the Sheraton brand through long-term management agreements.
FelCor will provide the capital to acquire certain existing Sheraton Hotels as well as other hotels that will be converted to the Sheraton brand.
